passages.heading: Overview of new-hire forms
passages.passage_text: You will complete most of your required forms during orientation on your first day. Most forms are completed online in Maple Connect, the company's HR portal. HR will show you how to sign in during orientation.

passages.heading: Employment eligibility form (I-9)
passages.passage_text: You must complete Section 1 of Form I-9 by the end of your first day. HR must review your identity and work eligibility documents within three business days of your start date. Bring your documents on your first day so this step can be completed on time.

passages.heading: Tax withholding forms
passages.passage_text: Complete the federal Form W-4 and your state tax withholding form on your first day. These forms tell payroll how much tax to withhold from your pay. You can update them at any time in Maple Connect.

passages.heading: Direct deposit and pay schedule
passages.passage_text: Submit the direct deposit form with your bank's routing number and your account number within your first week. Until direct deposit is set up, your pay will be mailed to you as a paper check. Employees are paid every other Friday, and your first paycheck arrives on the second Friday after your start date.

passages.heading: Emergency contact form
passages.passage_text: Add at least one emergency contact in Maple Connect within your first week. Keep this information up to date so the company can reach someone if you are hurt or ill at work.

passages.heading: Policy acknowledgment forms
passages.passage_text: Within your first 14 days, sign the acknowledgment forms for the Employee Handbook and the Code of Conduct. Signing confirms that you have received and read these policies.

passages.heading: Benefits enrollment form
passages.passage_text: If you are eligible for benefits, complete the benefits enrollment form in Maple Connect within 30 days of your start date. For plan details and eligibility, see HR-02, Benefits.

passages.heading: Missed deadlines and help with forms
passages.passage_text: If a form is late, HR will send you a reminder. A late I-9 can affect your ability to continue working, so complete it first. For help with any form, contact the HR Service Desk at extension 2200.
